The KeepKosher app was created to make the world of kashrut accessible to Jews in Israel and all over the world.
On the app, you can find information about leading kosher restaurants in Israel, as well as view details about kosher food products worldwide. The app shows the kosher certification agency, a copy of the kosher certificate, details of the supervision, mashgiach and information about his presence at the business, along with the kosher certification of the ingredients and cooking practices.
Have you ever struggled to find kosher food outside of Israel, or a restaurant with kashrut standards and practices that suit your needs? We’re here to help you.
We launched KeepKosher, a free app for the benefit of kashrut observers everywhere.
We believe in honesty, information sharing, and transparency when working with restaurants and factories.
The app is a dream come true for us. We realized that there was no unified, updated, tech-based database of kosher food products and restaurants. Our goal is to make this information accessible, save time and resources, and diversify the rich flavors available to kashrut observers in Israel and worldwide.
We believe in cultivating Jewish identity in the State of Israel and throughout the Jewish world. Collecting updated kashrut information will bring more people together and emphasize the common ground between all Jews – all in adherence with Jewish law. 
After verifying the validity of the kosher certificates at the restaurants, we collected information provided by the restaurants and which appears in the kashrut databases in Jewish communities worldwide.
We are aware of the need to update the app frequently and are working to keep the information current at all times. We would be happy to hear from you as well in this regard.
We hope that you will find this app useful, and we feel that is our reward.

Thank you,
KeepKosher
